cim: Introducing Scribe v3 and Scribe v3 Live: our most accurate Speech to Text models yet.
cim_eredeti: Introducing Scribe v3 and Scribe v3 Live: our most accurate Speech to Text models yet.
szoveg_eredeti:
Introducing Scribe v3 and Scribe v3 Live: our most accurate Speech to Text models yet.

Built for real-world audio, these models handle extreme background noise, know a pause from the end of a sentence, and keep track of who said what in a busy meeting.

In our internal evaluations, Scribe v3 had the best transcription and diarization (who said what, and when) accuracy of any model we tested. Scribe v3 Live supports diarization for the first time and makes 43% fewer errors than its predecessor.

 Eneco supplies energy to more than 2 million homes and businesses. With Scribe v3 Live in ElevenAgents, its voice agent captured Dutch postcodes correctly on the first try 40% more often. That’s thousands of callers who don’t have to repeat themselves.

Turn detection in Scribe v3 Live now draws on the context of the whole conversation rather than silence alone. A new key term library holds up to 10,000 terms, enough for a full legal or medical vocabulary. Scribe v3 also supports transcript edits in plain English.

Scribe v3 Live is available in ElevenAgents today, and both models are available in ElevenAPI. Scribe v3 is also the default in the ElevenLabs app.
